ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity black region forming a wide 'V' base at the peduncle attachment, extending laterally with irregular, serrated margins. High-intensity white/cream contiguous regions occupy the outer 60% of each lobe, featuring scattered low-intensity focal spots and feathery transitional boundaries along the interior margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-6 pixel peaks) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity and deeper 'valleys' observed towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters detected on the distal white regions of both lobes, appearing more concentrated on the right lobe (viewer's perspective).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Isolated thin, dark diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) visible on the left lobe distal surface and near the central pigmentation boundary of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Numerous small-scale trailing edge nicks and irregular serrations indicating cumulative physical wear; no major amputations or large lesions detected.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark pigment clusters and more extreme serration at the distal tips, especially on the rightmost edge.
